### Comparison
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-july-12-2021.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 10:12
Points:
- Comparing yourself to others leads either to smug pride or to feelings of inferiority.
- Emulating external human standards tempts you to abandon your genuine identity for a disguise.
- Constantly comparing others against each other damages self-esteem and stifles motivation.
- God intentionally created individuals with differences and variety rather than identical uniformity.
- True spiritual maturity embraces personal design and focuses on fulfilling God's distinct plan.

### Taking Every Thought Captive - Part 4: Reject the Lie
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-aug-6-2007-11550102.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 10:5
Points:
- Spiritual victory is easiest when false ideas are stopped right at the doorway of the mind.
- Strongholds develop when recurring deceptive thoughts and traumas become fortified mental habits.
- Human willpower alone cannot tear down spiritual fortresses without the Holy Spirit's power.
- Deceptive internal calculations must be confronted and rejected immediately.
- Believers disarm lies of failure and inadequacy by anchoring their thoughts in scripture.

### The Standards That Matter
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-standards-that-matter-bible-study-minute-june-5-2018.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 10:12
Points:
- False teachers made the mistake of setting their own benchmarks as the measure of righteousness.
- Measuring your life against human performance leaves you perpetually empty and chasing moving targets.
- Comparison causes believers to pursue someone else's calling while missing their own.
- Jesus provides the only standard that brings lasting satisfaction and true peace.
- Daily time spent in God's Word grounds believers in His divine purpose over worldly expectations.

### Don't Dare to Compare
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/dont-dare-to-compare-crosswalk-the-devotional-nov-30-2010-11640440.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 10:12
Points:
- The Corinthian rivals used self-commendation and rivalry rather than unity in Christ.
- Paul refused to participate in petty comparisons, choosing sarcasm to expose their foolishness.
- Paul measured his significance by faithful service within the assignment God entrusted to him.
- Seeking worth through positions, titles, or reputation amounts to deceitful self-flattery.
- Christians find enduring confidence by resting in Christ's identity rather than chasing human approval.
